title: Redemption of Common Stock Alongside Equity Signed Over Under Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
Common stock is redeemed at par alongside the equity once the membership has been held long enough to have paid for it.

**Where the membership is seasoned.** Where shares of common stock stand recorded on the membership and it has stood on the books 10 or more whole fiscal years, the shares recorded are redeemed at the class's par value.

**Where it is held but not yet seasoned.** Where shares stand recorded and the membership has stood on the books 3 or more but fewer than 10 whole fiscal years, they are redeemed at half the class's par value, that is at a share of 0.5 of it.

**Where it is neither.** Where fewer than 3 whole fiscal years have run or no shares stand recorded, no stock is redeemed.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical records

| Shares of common stock recorded | Whole fiscal years on the books | What is redeemed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 16 | the share recorded, at the class's par value |
| 1 | 10 | the share recorded, at the class's par value |
| 1 | 9 | the share recorded, at half the class's par value |
| 1 | 3 | the share recorded, at half the class's par value |
| 1 | 2 | nothing |
| none | 16 | nothing |

The two boundaries are at 10 and at 3 whole fiscal years, each of them satisfied at the year named and not below it. The years are counted in whole fiscal years from the date the Membership and Patronage Equity account was accepted, and the par value of one share is the figure the class schedule carries.

**Worked.** A membership carrying 1 share at a class par value of 25.00 redeems 25.00 on the first reading and 12.50 on the second, the figure being rounded to two decimal places.
